usedFor: Weaviate stores vector data: “Create a New Object Class” makes a collection and “Create a New Tenant” adds a tenant.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new product is created” in Fourthwall, then “Create a New Object Class” in Weaviate
bestTemplate.why: A new product can create a collection to hold its data.

watchOut: “Remove an Object Class” deletes the collection and all its objects, so check the name first.
